actions.action: Use the existing canonical task-agnostic /wc invocation as the executable universal entry envelope. Do not treat a short WC://ENTER alias plus URL as write authorization unless the human message itself contains the bounded authorization clause.

When a launched chat produces no beacon within the bounded local/client window, surface PRE_DURABLE_BOUNDARY_OR_TIMEOUT instead of indefinite waiting. Permit at most one identical fresh-shell retry for an isolated pre-beacon transport/safety failure; repeated same-class failure escalates through existing GUIDE_RESCATE.

Keep NO_PRIMARY_WORK nonterminal: traverse the existing metabolism ladder (integration, planner pressure, rescate, critic, grounded system/discovery work, bounded reload) and only then allow TURN_COMPLETE with exhaustion evidence.

live_entry_transport_canary.conclusion: Inline-authorized entry can cross E1 and E2 through the current GitHub connector.
